title: The user dismisses a wrong not-addressed entry and then presses Refresh
expected: Once the user dismisses the entry it stays dismissed when the recap is rebuilt, and Refresh asks the model again rather than giving back the same reading.

steps.user: Delete the old migrations folder, we don't need those files anymore.

steps.agent: I'd leave db/migrations in place. The deploy script replays every migration on a fresh database, and staging is rebuilt from scratch each night, so deleting them would break tonight's rebuild. If you want less clutter I can squash them into one baseline migration instead. I have not deleted anything.

check.why: an entry the user dismissed does not come back when the recap is rebuilt
Refresh asks the model again: it is how the user gets a second reading of a recap that looks wrong
